articles.description: During his Tuesday start vs. the Giants, Cardinals starter Andre Pallante allowed a career-high eight runs. He saw how a lack of execution in two-strike counts can prove costly.

articles.title: Cardinals left with 10-3 loss to Giants after Andre Pallante's rocky start
articles.description: One of the Cardinals' most reliable starters this year, Andre Pallante was charged with a season-high eight runs (six earned) over five innings in a loss to the Giants.

articles.title: Cardinals produced ‘when it mattered,' but contact ends in outs in latest 1-run game
